subject: Ciências
description_pt: Descrever a composição e a estrutura do Sistema Solar (Sol, planetas rochosos, planetas gigantes gasosos e corpos menores), assim como a localização do Sistema Solar na nossa Galáxia (a Via Láctea) e dela no Universo (apenas uma galáxia dentre bilhões).

components.description_pt: Descrever as categorias de corpos que compõem o Sistema Solar, incluindo o Sol, planetas rochosos, gigantes gasosos e corpos menores
components.description_en: Describe the categories of bodies that compose the Solar System, including the Sun, rocky planets, gas giants, and smaller bodies
components.cc_component_description: Identify the objects that make up the solar system and their organizational relationships

components.description_pt: Distinguir planetas rochosos de planetas gigantes gasosos com base em suas características físicas
components.description_en: Distinguish between rocky planets and gas giant planets based on their physical characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Compare the characteristics of different objects in the solar system, including planets, moons, and asteroids

components.description_pt: Identificar o Sistema Solar terrestre como um componente dentro da galáxia Via Láctea
components.description_en: Identify Earth's solar system as one component within the Milky Way galaxy
components.cc_component_description: Identify Earth's solar system as one component within the Milky Way galaxy

components.description_pt: Descrever a escala e estrutura do universo, incluindo a existência de múltiplas galáxias
components.description_en: Describe the scale and structure of the universe, including the existence of multiple galaxies
components.cc_component_description: Describe the scale and structure of the universe, including the existence of multiple galaxies

cc_matches.description: Earth and its solar system are part of the Milky Way galaxy, which is one of many galaxies in the universe.
The solar system consists of the sun and a collection of objects, including planets, their moons, and asteroids that are held in orbit around the sun by its gravitational pull on them.
